meta.description: Sprint 4: gera asset/conteúdo para Instagram via APIs oficiais Meta. Sem browser automation. Produtos Shopee elegíveis podem usar marcação oficial quando disponível.

parameters.query:
WITH settings AS (
  SELECT * FROM channel_settings WHERE channel = 'instagram' AND enabled = TRUE
),
today AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM publications
  WHERE channel = 'instagram' AND status = 'published' AND published_at::date = CURRENT_DATE
)
SELECT p.id, p.title, p.image_url, p.affiliate_url, p.source, p.ai_content_angle, p.price, p.rating, p.sold_count
FROM products p
CROSS JOIN settings s
CROSS JOIN today t
WHERE p.active AND p.ai_publishable = TRUE
  AND t.cnt < s.max_posts_per_day
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM channel_rules r
    WHERE r.source = p.source AND r.channel = 'instagram' AND r.allowed = TRUE
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM publications pub
    WHERE pub.product_id = p.id AND pub.channel = 'instagram' AND pub.status = 'published'
      AND pub.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  )
ORDER BY p.opportunity_score DESC
LIMIT 1;
